fields.rule: Store as text to preserve leading zeros.

fields.rule: Do not infer mobile status or country code.

fields.label: DoB

fields.label: URL
fields.rule: Keep domain and full URL distinguishable. Do not invent a protocol.

fields.label: Merchant Category

fields.label: Company Name
fields.rule: Preserve the reported company. Keep it separate from merchant and target.

fields.label: Alias Name
fields.rule: Preserve the reported alias. Link it to a person only with evidence.

fields.label: Age
fields.rule: Preserve reported age and units. Do not derive it from date of birth.

fields.label: Place of Birth
fields.rule: Keep birthplace separate from current or previous address.

fields.label: Occupation
fields.rule: Use the occupation or job title explicitly reported by the source.

fields.rule: Use an organisation explicitly identified as an employer.

fields.rule: Preserve the target role. Keep it separate from company and merchant.

fields.rule: Use explicit merchant evidence. Keep company and target separate.

fields.label: Previous Address
fields.rule: Use an address explicitly described as previous or former.

fields.label: Account Type
fields.rule: Use the reported account type. Link it only to the supported account.

fields.label: Total Amount
fields.rule: Preserve the reported total and its scope. Do not calculate a new total.

fields.rule: Use an explicit currency code. Do not infer from an ambiguous symbol.
